# Contact group list — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the contact group list when the contacts arrive in groups and one of them is current: the selectable grouped list over contact data. `groups` carry the shared adapter rows, so pickers and directories share the shape, and grouping is order-preserving with ungrouped contacts under their own heading. Selection is controlled or uncontrolled through the canonical `value`, `defaultValue` and `onValueChange` trio carrying one contact id — there is no multi-select, because choosing several is a different component. `onSelect` fires beside selection for hosts that navigate on top of selecting: selecting and acting are different intents, so they stay separate callbacks. There is no search inside; filtering is the directory's job and the group list renders the groups it is given.
